en: Colorized historic view of an ornate red-brick railway station building with towers and arched windows. In front are people with handcarts and horse-drawn vehicles on a wide square. Trees and a streetlamp stand to the left. The caption at the top reads in Hungarian about Pécs railway station. The reverse side is an unused divided-back postcard with Hungarian text "Levelezö-Lap" and a printed postage imprint for 10 fillér.
